items.definition:
a spacecraft designed to land on a celestial body
The Mars lander successfully touched down on the red planet.

a broad, heavy knife used as an implement or weapon
He used a machete to clear the thick jungle undergrowth.

the activity of promoting the sale of goods
Effective merchandising is crucial for retail success.

a slimy substance secreted by mucous membranes
The doctor explained that mucus helps protect the respiratory system.

a tree or its sweet, edible fruit
We picked fresh mulberries from the tree in the garden.

a person who studies natural history
The naturalist spent years observing wildlife in the Amazon.

a sudden release of strong emotion
His sudden outburst of anger surprised everyone.

a doctor who studies diseases
The pathologist examined the tissue sample under the microscope.

the preservation of peace
The UN deployed a peacekeeping force to the region.

a hidden or unsuspected danger or difficulty
One common pitfall for new businesses is underestimating costs.

illegal hunting or fishing
Wildlife conservationists are fighting against elephant poaching.

a device consisting of a bar or wheel with a set of angled teeth
He used a ratchet to tighten the bolt.

a deep, narrow gorge with steep sides
The hikers carefully descended into the deep ravine.

A fat used in baking
The recipe calls for vegetable shortening.

A game in which one side prevents the other from scoring
The team achieved a shutout, winning 3-0.

A tool with a curved blade and short handle, used for cutting grain
The farmer used a sickle to cut the tall grass.

A short comedy sketch or piece of acting
The students performed a funny skit for the assembly.

A stone slab or pillar, often inscribed, set at the head of a grave
The old tombstone was covered in moss.

A river or stream flowing into a larger river or lake
The small stream is a tributary of the main river.

a shortened form of a word or phrase
Dr. is an abbreviation for Doctor.

the action or process of adhering to a surface or object
The strong adhesion of the glue made it difficult to remove.

a history or background, especially one created for a fictional character
The author provided a detailed backstory for the main character.

a marshy outlet of a lake or river
They took a boat trip through the Louisiana bayou.

a hard, brittle, metallic element
Chromium is often used to make stainless steel.

an item valued and sought by collectors
Old comic books can be valuable collectibles.

a line or circle of police, soldiers, or guards preventing access to or from an area or building
The police set up a cordon around the crime scene.

reduction in the number or quantity of something
The depletion of natural resources is a serious concern.

a feeling of annoyance or dissatisfaction
The manager expressed his displeasure with the team's performance.

a person or thing that finishes something
He's a strong finisher in long-distance races.

an unlikely chance occurrence, especially a surprising piece of luck
His win was a complete fluke.

a protective glove, typically of leather and steel, worn by a knight in armor
The knight threw down his gauntlet as a challenge.

A typeface in which the letters slope to the right
The word was printed in italic to emphasize its importance.

A person or thing that brings bad luck; a spell of bad luck
Don't say that, you'll jinx it!

a small songbird; a playful adventure
The lark sang sweetly in the morning sky.

a connection or relationship
There is a clear linkage between diet and health.

a hairstyle; a member of a Native American tribe
He sported a bold mohawk haircut.

nothing
I asked him what he found, and he said 'nada'.

a large gland behind the stomach that secretes digestive enzymes and hormones
The pancreas plays a vital role in digestion and blood sugar regulation.

a sitting room in a private house; a shop providing a specified service
We sat in the parlour and enjoyed a cup of tea.

the person in charge of a post office
The postmaster ensured all mail was delivered on time.

a match or round preceding the semifinal
The team advanced to the quarterfinal after winning their last match.

the process of claiming something back or of reasserting a right
The reclamation of the land after the flood took many years.

the action of settling or being settled in another place
The government initiated a program for the resettlement of refugees.

a sudden and disturbing or surprising event or news
The news of his resignation was a real shocker.

an abdominal organ involved in the production and removal of blood cells
The spleen plays an important role in the immune system.

a place of residence; a house or home
Welcome to my humble abode.

someone who supports a particular party, person, or set of ideas
He was a strong adherent of the new policy.

a share or portion of something assigned or distributed
Each family received an allotment of land.

a list of people or things viewed with suspicion or disapproval
His name was put on the blacklist.

a stupid or careless mistake
He made a serious blunder in the negotiation.

a drink taken after a stronger one; someone or something that chases
He ordered a whiskey with a beer chaser.

a person who composes the sequence of steps and moves for a dance or other performance
The choreographer designed the ballet's intricate movements.

a state of confused and noisy disturbance
There was a great commotion in the street.

the state or quality of being complete
The completeness of the report was impressive.

a hotel employee who helps guests
The concierge helped us book a taxi to the airport.

the number below the line in a common fraction
In the fraction 3/4, 4 is the denominator.

property or money brought by a bride to her husband on their marriage
In some cultures, a dowry is still an important part of marriage traditions.

a house divided into two apartments
They bought a duplex and rented out the other half.

a section or speech at the end of a book or play
The epilogue revealed what happened to the characters years later.

the action of floating
The life jacket provides excellent flotation.

a short introduction to a book
The author wrote a heartfelt foreword to the new edition.

lack of action where some action is expected or necessary
The government's inaction on climate change is a major concern.

an enclosed apparatus for premature babies; a place for new businesses
The startup moved into a new business incubator.

the state of being related by blood or marriage; a sharing of characteristics or origins
There was a strong sense of kinship among the team members.
